testcase.name: depends on the published SDK and does not fork hacienda-cr
injects taxpayer secrets from the Kubernetes secret and selects sandbox on dev and staging
does not listen when the password is missing
listens on port 50051 after credentials load
uses the full issued username without taxpayer ID validation
retains identification-based credentials when no username is configured
sends sandbox authentication to the rut-stag identity provider
sends production authentication to the rut identity provider
preserves the issued username without requiring or reconstructing a taxpayer ID
rejects blank or whitespace-bearing explicit usernames instead of using legacy IDs
redacts the full username and password in startup errors
reads the four Hacienda variables
fails closed when the password is missing
rejects an environment other than sandbox or production
does not embed a credential literal
records credentials_not_configured and does not call the identity provider
rejects a token URL that is not loopback
redacts a token type that repeats the password
writes a secret-free CSV when the token endpoint accepts the password
preserves the issued sandbox username through gRPC login, refresh and re-authentication
preserves the issued production username through gRPC login, refresh and re-authentication
reports a real SDK authentication rejection without exposing IDP details
reports failure and omits secrets when credentials are rejected
returns a non-empty access token when the SDK authenticates
returns the SDK token on a later fetch without a caller-supplied token
authenticates once when refresh fails and still takes no caller token
